title: When Will Crypto Stop Being Boring?
summary: Casual Friday episode after 7-month hiatus. Hosts discuss crypto's underperformance relative to stocks, gold, silver. Main thesis: crypto has been boring and weak while other asset classes rip. They're cautiously neutral, leaning slightly bearish, recommending patience and clear invalidation levels rather than forcing trades in choppy conditions.
key_themes: Celebrity meme coin extraction/grift damage to reputation
Privacy coins (XMR, ZEC) as only working narrative
Breakout trading has been miserable - ATH breaks are top signals
Risk-adjusted returns in crypto are poor

trading_recommendations.overall_stance: Stay on sidelines unless strong conviction. Pick a side, set clear invalidation, stick with it.

bullish_case.entry: Can be long now but aggressive
bullish_case.invalidation: $90K - below this likely leads to new lows
bullish_case.timeframe: Daily chart is only supportive timeframe

bearish_case.entry: Wait for sub-$93K to confirm failed breakout

mentions.speaker: Cred
mentions.context: BTC dropped from $110K to $90K while everything else rallied. The 'catchup logic' is dangerous - sometimes weakness is just weakness.
mentions.quote: Crypto was just lagging, man. And I think if viewed in a vacuum, there were a lot of decent arguments to just either rebalance or cut some aggressive exposure

mentions.speaker: Duck
mentions.context: Weekly chart shows weakness at resistance. Need to close above range low ($94.8K) for bullish setup. $102-104K reclaim needed for aggressive bullishness.
mentions.quote: I generally don't hate the charts... but it is not good just considering that everything else been going up non-stop and that the dollar's like lost in value

mentions.speaker: Duck
mentions.context: ETH/BTC has held up surprisingly well compared to other alts - 'actually one of the better altcoins'. ETH/USD bouncing from weekly support but choppy.
mentions.quote: EUSD is not the end of the world on the weekly time frame. It's just the same kind of story where we basically made a new alltime high and nothing happened

mentions.speaker: Duck
mentions.context: SOL stuck in range since March 2024. Weak bounce at 'last level ever'. Would not want to be long looking at how it looks.
mentions.quote: I would not want to be bullish this thing looking at how it looks... the weekly chart looks horrendous to me. That's a very weak bounce considering that this is the last level

mentions.speaker: Cred
mentions.context: SOL's support is 'the new 6K' - tested many times. If it breaks, will teleport down. But range has held for almost a year.
mentions.quote: Soul will just never give up that monthly level clearly as long as we're alive

mentions.speaker: Duck

market_context.crypto_vs_tradfi: Crypto massively underperforming. S&P at ATH, gold/silver ripping, commodities strong. Crypto stuck in 10% range.
market_context.sentiment: Bad and for good reason. Reputation damaged by celebrity coin grifts and mass extraction.
market_context.volatility: Lower than usual, making crypto less attractive on risk-adjusted basis
market_context.correlations: Higher correlation with traditional markets now - can no longer ignore macro
